summary: Frontend-only E2E across BOTH surfaces for the 4-phase drop (web login/register, mobile Hub-first + Crew Bank, mobile Admin, mobile reactions + one-photo). ALL requested flows PASS. WEB: /login and /register both render the login-page shell with auth-tab-login / auth-tab-register / auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-btn / auth-google-btn; on /register the tab is pre-selected, and choosing reg-type-boat_owner correctly reveals reg-extra-input with placeholder 'Boat name'. Registering a unique account (test.reg.web.1789094873@example.com / hunter2pass / Boat Owner / TEST Auto Boat / Greater Seattle) lands on /dashboard and /api/auth/me returns the new user. Login tab on the same account signs in and lands on /dashboard. Header 'Sign in' (login-btn) navigates to /login. Admin login jenn@sailmorenow.com / [REDACTED] authenticates as platform_role='admin' and admin UI (/admin/analytics, admin-menu in header) is reachable. Wrong-password shows auth-error='Incorrect email or password'. InviteBanner: on /?ref=Jane (logged out) invite-banner + invite-signup-btn render; tapping the button now routes to /register?ref=Jane (NOT Google). When logged in the banner is hidden on the same URL. MOBILE: Hub tab is the first tab labeled 'Hub'; all 7 filter chips hub-filter-{all,feed,forum,blog,sailing,volunteer,crew} render; market-selector-btn opens the market sheet with market-opt-<name> options; hub-compose-fab opens a create sheet with the 4 options (New post / New forum topic / New blog post / New event). Crew filter reveals open-crew-bank-btn, which opens /crew-bank. /crew-bank renders 'Crew Bank' with crew-market-<name> chips and the open-events section (1 crew-open card returned by the backend this run). Admin dashboard: signed in as jenn@sailmorenow.com; Profile shows admin-dashboard-row (hidden for non-admin seed_marina); the row opens /admin with admin-tab-{overview,reports,approvals,bans}. Overview renders analytics stats (Members=21, Active(7d)=5, Posts=6, Events=23, Upcoming=20, Comments=1, Open reports=0, Pending posts=1); Bans tab shows ban-ip-input + ban-reason-input + add-ban-btn. Reactions: on the first post detail /post/[id] react-up-<id> / react-down-<id> render with counts; tapping toggles the count deterministically (0 → 1 → 0). Same testIDs work on a forum discussion detail /hub/[id]. Photo picker: photo-add-btn is present on both /new-post and /hub/new; tapping does not crash the app (native picker cannot open in web-preview, per spec — no red screen). Regression: existing tabs (Events, Boat Pros, Messages, Profile) all load with content.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx correctly reuses the same page for /login and /register via the App.js route (both point to <Login />) and derives initial `mode` from either ?mode=register or window.location.pathname === '/register' — good.

Login.jsx submit does NOT preserve ?ref=... after registration (the InviteBanner passes ?ref=Jane to /register but the value is not sent to /api/auth/register nor persisted for attribution). Not a blocker for this drop but worth wiring up if you want referral attribution end-to-end.

InviteBanner.jsx uses window.location.href = '/register?...' which causes a full page reload instead of client-side navigation (react-router Navigate/useNavigate would be smoother). Functionally correct — verified — but adds an unnecessary hard-refresh.

mobile/(tabs)/_layout.tsx renames the first tab to 'Hub' with tab-icon 'compass-outline' — the file is still named `feed.tsx` and the component exported is `Hub`. Fine, but a rename to hub.tsx would remove confusion for future maintainers (and lets you drop the 'feed' path).

mobile/(tabs)/feed.tsx: compose sheet uses `testID={`compose-${o.go}`}` which produces testIDs like `compose-/hub/new?kind=forum` (contains slashes and `?`). Playwright & most selectors handle it OK but attribute selectors have to be quoted; consider slug testIDs (e.g. `compose-forum`) for stability.

mobile/src/components/PhotoPicker.tsx: uses `mediaTypes: ['images']` — the newer expo-image-picker API. Good. Sends a base64 data URL as image_url; server should validate size — large images may blow up JSON payload limits. Consider a max size / compression check upstream.

mobile/src/components/Reactions.tsx: `react` catches all errors silently (`/* ignore */`). If reactions API returns an error the user gets no feedback. Consider a toast on failure — verified working today but adding UX resilience is cheap.

mobile/app/admin.tsx: `if (user && user.platform_role !== 'admin') return <Redirect />;` — correct gating; `if (!user) return <Redirect href='/' />;` — good; both verified with jenn (admin) and seed_marina (non-admin, admin-dashboard-row hidden).

mobile/app/crew-bank.tsx: crew-market chips render but standalone entries were empty this run (0 entries). Not a bug — depends on premium listings — but ensure the seed data creates at least one for future automated checks.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all web (login/register/InviteBanner routing/admin) and mobile (Hub, Crew Bank, Admin tabs, Reactions toggle, Photo pickers, regression tabs) flows requested in this iteration passed.

Fresh registered user this run: test.reg.web.1789094873@example.com / hunter2pass (Boat Owner, Greater Seattle). Mobile Bearer tokens minted via mongosh: seed_marina token test_session_mobile_1789094938843, admin jenn token test_session_mobile_admin_1789095067315 (both in test_database.user_sessions).
seed_data_creation: 1 web-registered user (test.reg.web.1789094873@example.com). 2 user_sessions rows inserted for the mobile flow (seed_marina + jenn admin). No content was posted; only reactions were toggled and then reverted (net-zero). Main agent may prune TEST_* test users and test_session_mobile_* sessions if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web + mobile e2e tooling both work reliably. Patterns used: (WEB) target REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, viewport 1280x900, wait_for_selector on [data-testid=login-page] with 15s; after auth-submit-btn use wait_for_url('**/dashboard**') and confirm via /api/auth/me with credentials:'include'; auth-error is surfaced immediately on bad login. (MOBILE) target the expo.preview URL, viewport 428x920, ALWAYS preseed the session_token via add_init_script BEFORE goto (Expo router bootstraps AuthContext once on cold load — after a /signin form submission the follow-up goto to another route does not pick up the newly-written localStorage). Reactions toggle deterministically: 0 → 1 → 0. Compose sheet testIDs use full paths as suffix (compose-/hub/new?kind=forum) — safe to select by testID prefix but consider slugging in future.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Only design observations: (1) InviteBanner triggers a full page reload via window.location.href instead of client-side navigation, and (2) the ?ref=<handle> query param is not forwarded from /register through /api/auth/register, so referral attribution is not persisted for email/password signups. Both are optional polish, not part of this drop's success criteria.
